definitions.short: Ziza , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H2124. Ziza זִיזָא proper name, masculine — 1 a Simeonite 1Chr 4:37 . 2 a son of Rehoboam 2Chr 11:20 .
definitions.rootNote: apparently from the same as 2123 ; prominence;

occurrences.englishText: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—
After her, he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
